title: pneumonanthe viscosa
intro: Pneumonanthe viscosa, commonly known as sticky lungwort, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pneumonanthe viscosa include soothing coughs, reducing inflammation, and relieving congestion, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
